description.text: Main Courses Discrete Mathematics, Data Structures and Algorithms, DigitalElectronicTtechnology, Computer Composition and Structure,Object-oriented Technology, Principle and Application of Database, Operatingsystem, Network and Communication Technology, SoftwareEngineering, User needs and System Modeling, Large DatabaseSystem Development, Comprehensive Chinese, listening, SpokenChinese

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Shenyang University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. Diploma of the Most Advanced Studies Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of graduate school 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Foreigner Physical Examination Form (Photocopy). 7.Study Plan in China. 8.Articles or Papers Written or Published. 9.Examples of Art (6 color pictures) and Music (1 audio tape) Work (Only for the applicants applying for Fine Arts and Music). 10.Application Form 11.Admission Letter or Admission Notice of Chinese Universitity Notes： 1.Each set of the complete materials should not exceed 20 pages. Please use DIN A4. 2.Whether the candidates are accepted or not, all the application materials will not be returned.

requirements.text: If you are in China now, please register directly in our university; if you want to attend the courses for Master Degree, make sure to have the following: new HSK Band 4，Graduation Certificate and Undergraduate Report from University; if you are not in China, you can come to China with your L or F visa, then we can help you to complete your formalities after your arrival at our university .
